description: This file defines the LeaveModuleController class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It extends an abstract controller and contains a method to handle leave module requests by redirecting to a default path obtained from a service.

classes.name: LeaveModuleController
classes.description: Controller handling requests for the leave module within the OrangeHRM leave plugin, primarily responsible for redirecting to the leave module's default page.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the leave module request, retrieves the default path from the home page service, and performs a redirect to that path.
